clusters.title: Installation failures and dependency fixes
clusters.summary: Users are encountering multiple installation-related issues including missing module imports, failed dependency installations for core packages like PyTorch and CLIP, and startup errors. Additionally, security vulnerabilities in the dependency cloning process pose supply chain risks. These problems prevent users from successfully setting up the development environment.
